summary: Feed s087_single to APM is degraded: 20.7% of frames are GRE-encapsulated and forwarded without decapsulation, hiding inner headers from the APM.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding GRE tunnel traffic without stripping the outer header. 356 of 1719 frames (20.7%) still carry GRE encapsulation, indicating the broker has no strip/decapsulate policy for this tunnel type.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM cannot parse inner IP/TCP headers and transaction payloads inside GRE, so flow correlation, latency and application metrics for ~20% of traffic will be incomplete or missed.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping GRE at the packet broker exposes the inner flow to the APM so it can correctly parse and measure application transactions without requiring tunnel awareness on the tool.
